sentences.text:
3. Contends that petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case and he is in custody for the last about 04 years; thus he be granted concession of bail pending trial.
4.
Per contra learned State counsel opposed the prayer of petitioner on the ground that he is not only a previous convict; rather facing numerous criminal cases.

5. Heard both sides and perused the paper-book.
6.
It transpires that present FIR was registered on 06.11.2014 and petitioner was declared as a 'proclaimed offender'.
Ultimately, he was arrested on 05.10.2019.

7. In response to the present petition, affidavit dated 27.07.2023 has been filed and para 11 thereof indicating the detail of cases against petitioner reads as under:-
"11.

That it is submitted that the petitioner is habitual offender and the following cases are against him:
i. FIR No.209, dated 07-08-2005 U/s 25/54/59 of Arms Act was registered at P.S.
Tanda, District Hoshiarpur against the petitioner and the same is pending trial.
ii. FIR No.25 dated 09.02.1999, U/s 356, 34 IPC was registered at P.S. Tanda, District Hoshiarpur against the petitioner and the petitioner was convicted in this case on 22.02.2007.
iii
FIR No.116, dated 21.05.2014 U/s 15/18/21/22-61-85 OF NDPS Act was registered at P.S. Tanda, District Hoshiarpur against the petitioner and the same is under investigation.

iv. FIR No.3, dated 7-1-2015 U/s 22/61/85 of NDPS Act was registered at P.S.
Bhogpur, District Jalandhar against the petitioner.
v. FIR No.98, dated 16.06.2000 U/s 380 IPC was registered at P.S. Adampur, District Jalandhar against the petitioner.

sentences.text: 8 . Perusal of above extract reveals that petitioner is an habitual offender, having no respect for the rule of law; thus, does not deserve the concession of bail pending trial, at this stage.

9. Although, petitioner has a right to seek speedy justice, but he himself delayed the proceedings,
which ultimately led to his declaration as a 'proclaimed offender'.
10. In such a scenario, this Court is not inclined to accept the prayer of petitioner and as a result thereof, there is no option except to dismiss the petition.

11. Ordered accordingly.
12.
It is clarified that observations made above shall not be construed as an expression of opinion on merits of the controversy, in any manner.
13. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed off.

16.11.2023 (MAHABIR SINGH SINDHU)
